messages:
renee-peopleops: Marta starts Tue. She's in LIS (Lisbon). Background check done but passport is in transit for renewal. She only has national ID for now. Need a remote onboarding plan that keeps Day 1 orientation while we wait for passport.

tom-recruiter: Marta can get a sworn affidavit at the Junta de Freguesia and a certified ID copy from the Conservatória. She can also do a live video verify.

renee-peopleops: Proposal: accept national ID + certified affidavit + recorded live video verify as temporary proof. Require passport or updated ID within 10 business days. No access to prod until updated ID. @security okay?

security: Acceptable with controls: recorded verify, secure upload, exception ticket SEC-2026-411. Limit system access to Slack guest + HR apps only. Flag payroll to delay tax activation until gov ID received.

it-support-bot: Device request placed: MacBook Air 13. Provision 48h, EU shipping 2-3bd. We'll mark device with MDM hold and ship once recorded verify attached. Tracking posted when shipped.

payroll: Payroll will hold first payroll activation until government ID is in file. We can process benefits enrollment Day 1 but benefits account activation will wait for verified ID.

marta-newhire: I can do video verify Mon 08:30 WEST and upload the affidavit tonight. Need confirm about reimbursement for certificate?

renee-peopleops: Reimbursement under ONB-INTL (use expense code ONB-PORTUGAL). We'll schedule the orientation intro Mon 11:00 WEST; you'll get guest Slack access after video verify. Ticket SEC-2026-411 created.

tom-recruiter: Sending secure upload link and calendar invites now. Closing loop once tracking and gov ID uploaded.
